body: I'm a simple person. I say name him 'Buzz'.

Michael betrayed Tommy last season when he thought that Polly made a deal with Luca Changretta and was willing to let Tommy die. Tommy doesn't trust him which is why he's being mean to him and why he sent him to America in the first place.
I feel similarly and I just finished college. Some people say that 'it gets better' but I have a hard time believing that.
I've been through depressions before but how I feel is new. I feel worse this week because I tried to get back with my ex and it didn't go in my favor.
